name: Moonwell cbETH OEV feed denomination mismatch
summary: Moonwell's ChainlinkOracle expects each configured feed to return a USD-denominated value. MIP-X43 instead assigned cbETH a CBETH/ETH wrapper that returned the roughly 1.12 exchange ratio, so getUnderlyingPrice valued one cbETH at about $1.12 rather than $2,206.68. This made healthy cbETH-backed accounts liquidatable for negligible debt repayment and made cbETH cheap to over-borrow.

loss.notes: Moonwell's live remediation ledger values each affected liquidation at its contemporaneous corrected collateral and debt prices, then defines borrower net loss as collateral seized minus debt repaid. Its 859 rows total $5,516,843.594852737 seized minus $2,811,445.0752305076 repaid = $2,705,398.519622221. One $45.997226547535 rETH/cbXRP liquidation in transaction 0xa8c0a1783c947d4fa9b95cf14771ad25c712dad860ae274700f02ea83443653f predates the bad configuration by 9 hours 43 minutes and is excluded. The remaining 858 rows total $2,705,352.522395674, reported here to cents. The post-mortem's earlier $1,779,044.83 was a protocol bad-debt snapshot, not this borrower-equity loss. Later remediation payments do not reduce incident-time loss.

ageReset.description: MIP-X43 changed the cbETH feed from composite oracle 0xb0ba0c5d7da4ec400c1c3e5ef2485134f89918c5 to CBETH/ETH wrapper 0x67996d1ff7a3711a91e2839d1059fcb950c0495d. Across the execution block getUnderlyingPrice(mcbETH) fell from 2,206.683650838065175827e18 to 1.122662744874806300e18.

sources.note: Anchor and configuration: MIP-X43 transaction 0xd26baf29dcba7bf66db4be17b46a49bb4dacca41ace968c98c8a5b09a03ae812 at block 42194663:107 emitted the cbETH FeedSet event at log 817 and changed getFeed(cbETH) from 0xb0ba0c5d7da4ec400c1c3e5ef2485134f89918c5 to 0x67996d1ff7a3711a91e2839d1059fcb950c0495d. The declared historical call reproduces getUnderlyingPrice(mcbETH) changing from 2,206.683650838065175827e18 at block 42194662 to 1.122662744874806300e18 at block 42194663. Account 0x48426b1de4715974407f19d4682795fe8f97bcdd had 5.217653575432785972e18 liquidity, zero shortfall and an mcbETH balance immediately before the change. It was liquidated in the same block at index 190; that trace reads the malformed mcbETH price from the selected oracle before seizing USDC collateral for EURC debt. A receipt scan found no intervening Moonwell Borrow or LiquidateBorrow event after the reset, making this the earliest realized loss. Target history: ChainlinkOracle 0xec942be8a8114bfd0396a5052c36027f2ca6a9d0 was created top-level by 0xc3f9774af21a030ab785cb45510ba9edc9d0c8cd in transaction 0x5fc210b0dc604c3e91923b7641cce0fabbf6d2471bb1ae7da2c3f9ec0b8ada1a at block 2162491:7. Code is absent one block earlier and its direct runtime hashes to 0x71bd27bf1769455c19a40556cd1d3bee966615d5c3c0b9c87f659e31179b57fe both at deployment and at the anchor. Loss: the official dashboard's 859 entries reference 830 unique Base transactions. Every transaction exists and succeeded, every displayed timestamp matches its block, and every row id resolves to a LiquidateBorrow log whose borrower and liquidator match the dashboard. Summing the 203 borrower totals reproduces $2,705,398.519622221 and 1,377.2782232038535 WETH owed; the latter exactly matches the later DAO accounting of 169.26714134 distributed plus 1,208.01108186 remaining. Excluding the sole pre-reset row leaves the declared $2,705,352.52 causal net loss across 858 rows. The last included liquidation is transaction 0xd9b8a0abc3d48a80e6983734bb300af252c479db01197630e9854fbf69fb2c91 at block 42380069:233, timestamp 1771549485, before the correction at block 42538949:594.

limitations: USD marks use the official remediation ledger's per-liquidation corrected prices; transaction identity, ordering and LiquidateBorrow evidence were independently checked onchain.
